Every constant/context pair · wrapping unsigned32 arithmetic · Δ = CSD − original · LUT4 primary, carry descriptive
Fixed eight-constant × four-context grid. No pair filtering or outcome-based rewrite selection. No population CI, device timing or CPU speedup claim.
Universal actual-RTL pair equality is separate from 2,148 sampled mapped-netlist checks per arm. Full original/CSD formulas remain in figure-data.json.
